formalPoints: Workflow orchestrates human/system steps; business rules decide outcomes.
commonMistakes: Memorizing the name of Workflow vs Rules without a failure example
howToApply: Use Workflow vs Rules explicitly in an architecture defense sentence
title: Workflow vs Rules
summary: Workflow orchestrates human/system steps; business rules decide outcomes.
explain: Workflow orchestrates human/system steps; business rules decide outcomes. In Odyssey simulations this is modeled at Tier 1–2 fidelity with explicit labels — verify production details in official SAP documentation.
analogy: Practical memory hook: associate "Workflow vs Rules" with a concrete failure mode you have seen or will simulate in a mission.
whyItMatters: If you cannot explain Workflow vs Rules in one minute, you will mis-diagnose related incidents.
mnemonic: NAME IT TO TAME IT: Say “Workflow vs Rules” + one failure mode out loud — if you can't, you don't own it yet. (Workflow → mechanism → failure)
useCases: Greenfield design workshop: decide if “Workflow vs Rules” is required given constraints (latency, clean-core, team skills).
Incident bridge: symptoms appear; use “Workflow vs Rules” to classify the failing hop before changing config.
Architecture review board: defend why you accepted residual risk around “Workflow vs Rules”.
